decision.reason: [ev-bd329a64ec5d] only says the Image Automation APIs (ImagePolicy, ImageRepository, ImageUpdateAutomation) are now generally available. It says nothing about what happens to environments that already use them: no changed default or behaviour, and no deprecation, removal or required migration of earlier beta versions. The surrounding text is all other feature highlights, and no upgrade-guide section mentions these APIs, so the evidence neither supports behavior-change nor rules out a failure kind. To decide, we need the upgrade guide or API changelog naming the GA version and saying whether the beta versions are deprecated or removed, or need migrating.
